recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man in a baseball cap and leather jacket, positioned on the right, balanced by distressed, textured typography and subtle floral filigree on a dark, moody background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Typography is vertically centered on the left third
Subtle background filigree mirrors the organic lines of the subject's clothing
High-contrast lighting between the subject's face and the deep black background
coreInvariants: Distressed, stamp-like texture on primary text
Warm, earthy color palette on the subject against a cool black void
Low-key lighting with soft shadows on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait cropped at the shoulders, offset to the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright, textured primary text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face to the text on the left, then down to the subtle filigree details in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space on the left side provides a canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and brown tones in the subject's hat and skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/light grey for the distressed primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the text/face and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones: ochre, sienna, charcoal

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif and bold sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Heavy distressing and erosion applied to all glyphs
High-waisted caps for the primary display text
Interlocking or overlapping flourishes between words
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'R' in the primary text feature extended flourishes or swashes that connect words.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed display serif paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Floral filigree/scrollwork in dark red/brown in the background
Small star icons flanking the subtitle

avoid: Clean modern sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slab-serif structure and condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a worn brown baseball cap and black leather jacket, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background should be deep black with very subtle, dark red floral filigree patterns on the left. Use warm, soft lighting on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a large, condensed, distressed slab-serif font in off-white on the left. Add a subtitle below it in a smaller, clean, wide-tracked sans-serif in a tan color, flanked by two small stars.

verificationChecks: Is the subject offset to the right?
Is the filigree subtle enough not to distract?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones and black?

adjustableVariables: Level of erosion on the typography
Subject's clothing style (e.g., denim instead of leather)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Specific star arrangements that mimic a trademarked logo
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the distress.
Ensure the subject's gaze is directed toward the viewer.
Verify the background filigree is dark enough to remain secondary.
Confirm the color of the subtitle matches the tones in the subject's hat.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a right-aligned gritty portrait with left-aligned eroded slab-serif typography over a dark, patterned negative space.
